The '''Goluud Minor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that contained the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Goluud Minor]].
